indicator_text: Cyclical patterns in funds or asset transfers that ultimately revert to the same origin across multiple accounts or entities, lacking a legitimate business rationale.

mapping.rule: At least 3 transfers, through at least 3 different accounts, each account paying once.
The first transfer starts at the origin account and the last one ends there.
Each transfer starts where the previous one ended, and the transfers are in time order.
Cannot be decided by a rule. If the record names a rationale, the validator only warns, and a person reviews it.

results.what: A → B → C → A, in time order
A → B → C → D, never returns to A

messages.message: The last leg must end at the origin account: the funds must return to where they started.

results.what: The third transfer happens before the second

messages.message: Legs must be in time order: a leg cannot happen before the one it follows.

results.what: Only two transfers, A → B → A

messages.message: A loop must pass through at least 3 different accounts, each paying once.
A loop needs at least 3 legs (two legs is a round trip, not a chain across multiple accounts).

results.what: A valid loop, but a business rationale is on record

messages.message: A business rationale is recorded for this cycle. IND02191 describes cycles that lack one: review before treating it as a match.

results.what: A finding: technique T0039 under tactic Layering
A finding: technique T0039 under a tactic the typology does not list for it

messages.message: The typology does not list this technique under the tactic the finding names.

sample:
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix amx: <https://example.org/amltrix/> .
@prefix ex:  <https://example.org/rules#> .
@prefix acc: <https://example.org/account/> .

# ---- should conform: A -> B -> C -> A, in time order
ex:loop-good a ex:LoopCandidate ; ex:origin acc:A ;
    ex:leg [ a ex:Leg ; ex:seq 1 ; ex:from acc:A ; ex:to acc:B ; ex:amount 9800.00 ; ex:at "2022-09-01T09:00:00"^^xsd:dateTime ] ,
           [ a ex:Leg ; ex:seq 2 ; ex:from acc:B ; ex:to acc:C ; ex:amount 9700.00 ; ex:at "2022-09-02T11:30:00"^^xsd:dateTime ] ,
           [ a ex:Leg ; ex:seq 3 ; ex:from acc:C ; ex:to acc:A ; ex:amount 9600.00 ; ex:at "2022-09-04T15:10:00"^^xsd:dateTime ] .

# ---- does not return to the origin: A -> B -> C -> D
ex:loop-open a ex:LoopCandidate ; ex:origin acc:A ;
    ex:leg [ a ex:Leg ; ex:seq 1 ; ex:from acc:A ; ex:to acc:B ; ex:amount 5000 ; ex:at "2022-09-01T09:00:00"^^xsd:dateTime ] ,
           [ a ex:Leg ; ex:seq 2 ; ex:from acc:B ; ex:to acc:C ; ex:amount 4900 ; ex:at "2022-09-02T09:00:00"^^xsd:dateTime ] ,
           [ a ex:Leg ; ex:seq 3 ; ex:from acc:C ; ex:to acc:D ; ex:amount 4800 ; ex:at "2022-09-03T09:00:00"^^xsd:dateTime ] .

# ---- the legs are out of time order (leg 3 happens before leg 2)
ex:loop-time a ex:LoopCandidate ; ex:origin acc:A ;
    ex:leg [ a ex:Leg ; ex:seq 1 ; ex:from acc:A ; ex:to acc:B ; ex:amount 7000 ; ex:at "2022-09-01T09:00:00"^^xsd:dateTime ] ,
           [ a ex:Leg ; ex:seq 2 ; ex:from acc:B ; ex:to acc:C ; ex:amount 6900 ; ex:at "2022-09-05T09:00:00"^^xsd:dateTime ] ,
           [ a ex:Leg ; ex:seq 3 ; ex:from acc:C ; ex:to acc:A ; ex:amount 6800 ; ex:at "2022-09-02T09:00:00"^^xsd:dateTime ] .

# ---- only two legs: a round trip between two accounts
ex:loop-short a ex:LoopCandidate ; ex:origin acc:A ;
    ex:leg [ a ex:Leg ; ex:seq 1 ; ex:from acc:A ; ex:to acc:B ; ex:amount 3000 ; ex:at "2022-09-01T09:00:00"^^xsd:dateTime ] ,
           [ a ex:Leg ; ex:seq 2 ; ex:from acc:B ; ex:to acc:A ; ex:amount 3000 ; ex:at "2022-09-02T09:00:00"^^xsd:dateTime ] .

# ---- conforms structurally, but a business rationale is on record: a warning, not a violation
ex:loop-rationale a ex:LoopCandidate ; ex:origin acc:A ; ex:documentedRationale "Intra-group cash pooling, agreement 2021-114" ;
    ex:leg [ a ex:Leg ; ex:seq 1 ; ex:from acc:A ; ex:to acc:B ; ex:amount 20000 ; ex:at "2022-09-01T09:00:00"^^xsd:dateTime ] ,
           [ a ex:Leg ; ex:seq 2 ; ex:from acc:B ; ex:to acc:C ; ex:amount 20000 ; ex:at "2022-09-01T10:00:00"^^xsd:dateTime ] ,
           [ a ex:Leg ; ex:seq 3 ; ex:from acc:C ; ex:to acc:A ; ex:amount 20000 ; ex:at "2022-09-01T11:00:00"^^xsd:dateTime ] .

# ---- findings: the typology lists T0039 under Layering (ML.TA0007), not under ML.TA0001
ex:finding-good a ex:Finding ; ex:technique amx:T0039 ; ex:tactic amx:ML.TA0007 .
ex:finding-bad  a ex:Finding ; ex:technique amx:T0039 ; ex:tactic amx:ML.TA0001 .
